sloka: ततः सीतामपश्यंस्तु रावणस्य निवेशने ।शोकसागरमासाद्य न पारमुपलक्षये ।। ५.५८.५२ ।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ sītāmapaśyaṁstu rāvaṇasya niveśane ।śokasāgaramāsādya na pāramupalakṣaye ।। 5.58.52 ।।।।

translations.english: "Not able to find Sita at the residence of Ravana I was immersed in an ocean of endless sorrow and did not know what to do.
